## Scope And Authority

- This is the authoritative status and force-rank index. [Backlog](backlog.md) holds acceptance criteria, dependencies, verification, and the disposition of every former active card.
- Deliver only Exchange Online configuration, mailbox operations, Exchange RBAC, email protection for Exchange recipients, Exchange-scoped governance, and the scripts, runbooks, evidence, and tests needed for that service.
- Tenant creation, subscription/license assignment, Entra identities/Conditional Access/PIM/consent, enterprise signing infrastructure, DNS/HTTPS hosting, tenant-wide Purview policy administration, SIEM onboarding, other M365 workloads, and vendor setup are outside this delivery backlog. Track their assumptions, risks, issues, and external dependencies in [RAID](RAID.md). Do not create other-party In Progress cards for them.
- EOP and licensed Defender email protection remain in scope only for Exchange recipients. Safe Documents, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams configuration do not. Exchange mailbox hold/IRM settings may consume approved legal policy; designing legal policy or provisioning Purview is not Exchange work.
- Removing a tenant dependency from this board is not a claim that the dependency is satisfied. Report Exchange conformance and external readiness separately; never relabel unknown external state as a verified Pass.
- EXR-002/003/005/006/007/008/009 retain Done for their bounded offline acceptance. EXR-001 and EXR-004 are reclosed on scoped acceptance and full-regression reconciliation; EXR-011-A01 (g13), EXR-010-A01 (g16), EXR-010-A03 (g42), EXR-010-A02 (g46), EXR-010-A08 (g51), EXR-010-A04 (g70), EXR-010-A05 (g85), EXR-010-A06 (g93) and EXR-010-A07 (g107) are closed on scoped acceptance, applicable affected regression reconciliation and independent review. EXR-007 completes inventory and proposal admission, not implementation of all recommendations. The current full suite is red; no full-green, live-service or release acceptance is claimed, and external readiness remains unconfirmed.

## Execution Rules

- Force rank is unique and binding: select the lowest-numbered eligible card. Dependencies must be Done with evidence; no fan-out heuristic may override this explicit user ranking.
- Standalone WIP limit: one implementation card. Explicit Cohorts use one implementation card per cohort under the [cohort protocol](cohorts.md). Generation 126 closes rank-23 EXR-011-A02 on independent **ACCEPT/PASS** review, completes Gold batch5 and releases all Gold owners/reservations. ApprovedAdapters attempts remain exhausted at **3/3**; no fourth product attempt occurred.
- Named Coworker invocation succeeded for the EXR-008 completion pass after earlier registration failures. Any fallback must retain the same single-worker limit, scope, ownership, review and no-tenant-operation constraints.
- Missing external prerequisites remain in RAID with an accountable role and verification condition. Leave affected Exchange work To Do and select the next eligible rank; do not invent a Blocked bucket or assign tenant work to the swarm.
- Every card uses negative-first Arrange-Act-Assert checks and one positive per behavioral unit. Add assertions within the card, including documentation and design cards.
- Done requires recorded passing verification and acceptance evidence. A green synthetic fixture is not live compatibility proof. Live validation needs explicit authorization and an independently supplied disposable environment.
- Preserve unrelated worktree changes. No blanket deletion of legacy tests or weakening of change safety to achieve a green run.

### Persisted Future Lane Queues

These generation-162 queue reservations/affinities reserve allocation identity only and may be persisted before dependency eligibility solely to prevent duplicate lane allocation and establish planned stewardship. They do not move a card from To Do, give it an owner or WIP slot, satisfy a dependency or external gate, create a repository/output path lock, authorize a worker, consume an attempt, provide an ACK or grant execution authority. Executable reservation/active ownership begins only after force-rank, dependency, external-prerequisite, WIP, quiescence and conflict checks and a fresh sole-canonical-writer generation-bound ACK. Active ranks 20, 25 and 27 are excluded; within each lane the order remains force-ranked and dependency-aware.

Rank 51 remains gated on genuine repository-maintainer approval; affinity is not approval. Ranks 57-59 remain gated on their stated RAID confirmations, live prerequisites and explicit permission, and rank 60 remains gated on all release dependencies. Shared entries have no cohort execution owner until the canonical writer assigns one after every gate is evidenced.

Automatic continuation is canonical-only: if one lane is blocked, stopped or awaiting an external dependency, other cohorts with valid current-generation ACKs and disjoint reservations continue without waiting. A blocked lane retains its active ownership only while workers and paths are safe and quiescent; otherwise the canonical writer parks/requeues the card, preserves evidence and assigns that cohort its next dependency-safe reserved card. Workers never self-authorize, transition or rebalance. Shared writable paths and integrated validation remain serialized.
